summary: Both backend (pytest, 6/6) and frontend (Playwright end-to-end) tests PASS for the prudent-analysis + demo-data feature set. Verified via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. (1) Company created with name only has score=null in DB and shows 'Non calculé' in the list and 'Score commercial : non calculé' (data-testid=score-not-calculated) on the detail — 0/100 is not shown. (2) Full-data company ('TEST_Alpha_Conseil…' with sector/city/site/email) analyzed via GPT-5.5 produces the exact 3-block layout ('A. Données disponibles', 'B. Informations manquantes ou non vérifiées', 'C. Hypothèses commerciales'), score-value 28/100 with 'Score provisoire basé sur les données du dossier', reliability note 'Fiabilité faible — aucune vérification extérieure effectuée', 'Données utilisées' + 'Données absentes' lists, 'Recherche extérieure : non effectuée', 'Service potentiel à explorer' + service_condition text. No categorical formulation ('aucun site', 'pas de LinkedIn', 'aucun tunnel') is present. (3) Name-only company analyzed shows both the 'Analyse insuffisante' banner and the data-testid=score-insufficient block in the score card. (4) POST /api/demo/seed creates 10 demo companies; data-testid=demo-notice bandeau appears mentioning 'exclues des statistiques'; data-testid=kpi-total is unchanged (excludes demos). demo-badge visible on demo company detail (data-testid=demo-badge). (5) data-testid=clear-demo-btn removes demos; dashboard + Entreprises continue to work.

issues: Radix warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Accessibility nit, non-blocking.

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the 'Ajouter une entreprise' and other Radix DialogContent components to silence Radix warning. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py analyze() sets score = int(score_res.get('score', 0)) even when analysis.insufficient=True. The frontend already handles this correctly by prioritizing the insufficient block (data-testid=score-insufficient) over the numeric score, but the raw stored score for an 'insufficient' analysis remains a low number rather than None. Consider setting score=None (or storing a separate 'provisional' flag) when analysis.insufficient is True so the list column also shows 'Non calculé' for insufficient cases — currently after analyzing a name-only company its list Score changes from 'Non calculé' to a number (observed 7) while the detail still displays the insufficient state.

ai_service.py score prompt asks LLM to set external_search_done=false explicitly. Consider forcing sd['external_search_done']=False server-side after parsing to guarantee traceability regardless of LLM response.
server.py update_company preserves score only if the incoming score is not None; that's correct. But bulk-status doesn't touch the score, good.

CompanyDetail.jsx: Block component ignores empty arrays and hides the section — good. Consider surfacing 'Aucune donnée' fallback in blocks A/B/C when the array is empty to make the traceability explicit.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_Beta_* and TEST_Alpha_Conseil_* companies during testing; all deleted at teardown. Demo dataset (10 companies) seeded then cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://prospectia-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Login is /login (password Prospectia2026! for pre-filled jp.koffi@prospectia.app). After login the dashboard route is '/'. Key data-testids for this feature set: seed-demo-btn, clear-demo-btn, demo-notice, kpi-total, demo-badge, add-company-btn, company-name-input, save-company-btn, delete-company-{id}, analyze-btn, score-not-calculated, score-insufficient, score-value. The 'Ajouter une entreprise' dialog has one text input per field with labels ('Nom *', 'Ville', 'Code postal', 'Téléphone', 'Site internet', 'Email générique'); use label-based selection because there's a hidden checkbox input in each row that skews input.nth() indexing. Website input has placeholder 'https://...'. AI analyze takes ~15-30s per call; wait up to 90s.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no bug found. Feature set is correctly implemented. Minor UX consideration flagged in critical_code_review_comments about the list Score column reverting from 'Non calculé' to a numeric score after an 'Analyse insuffisante' analysis; behavior in the detail view is however correct (score-insufficient block shown).
